title: SB 10 (2025) (2025) — Bars student IDs from public colleges as polling-place ID (per news); tracker abstract: proof of identification may not include a document issued by an educational institution
operative_text:
Student IDs from Indiana public colleges not valid voter ID: would ban the use of student IDs from Indiana public colleges and universities to prove someone's identity
Other provisions: [not examined; iga.in.gov unreachable]
